scope: One exploratory matched-start checkpoint comparison and a paired MedBook image-ablation diagnostic. Existing checkpoints and validation splits are read-only. No training or test access.
decoder: Original single-example canonical greedy protocol, bf16 SDPA, one beam, repetition penalty 1.0, checkpoint-specific processor, original pixel limits and normalized exact-match scorer.
pathvqa: Full validation for plain GSPO in disjoint round-robin shards, reusing prior full validation counts for the initial and adaptive checkpoints.
medbook: Full validation for all checkpoints. Primary input uses original images, with paired text-only diagnostic omitting the image item while preserving prompt wording. Compare correctness transitions from the shared checkpoint and across image conditions.
spacing_audit: Before scoring, compared prepared train and validation against MRCL training revisions 0a4545c and 2ad8a8d. All 1210 train and 130 validation active prompts and labels match the correction, and A-D option whitespace normalization is a no-op.
results: Aggregate counts and token totals only for release. Correctness bits in validation order stay in the private run directory; no images, answers, sample IDs or predictions in outputs.
